name: remove-migrated-legacy-artifacts
title: Remove migrated legacy artifacts
description: Clean up after the Type Overlay v2 migration: hard-delete the legacy .hexscope/structs.json once types.json is verified readable (instead of leaving an inert duplicate), and prune retired bundled-schema copies (e.g. .hexscope/schemas/structs.schema.json) from seedSchemaCopies. Guarded so no data is deleted when the new file is missing, corrupt, or newer than the build. No persisted-shape or schemaVersion change.
creator: deviousprophet
